title: Task
description: One benchmark problem. Produced by R2's ingestion, consumed by R1's sweep and R2's grader. The visible/hidden test separation is structural here rather than conventional: they are different fields, so a feature builder cannot reach hidden tests by accident.

task_id.description: Stable across regenerations of the corpus. Prefixed by dataset to keep ids unique when corpora are merged.

dataset.description: Source corpus, e.g. humaneval_plus, mbpp_plus, livecodebench.

prompt.description: What the model is shown. The only text a D0 feature builder may read.

visible_tests.description: Shown to the model and executable by the cascade at inference. Usable as a D1 feature.

hidden_tests.description: Held back. Determines the label and nothing else. Never shown to a model, never read by a feature builder.

contamination.description: R2's ingestion record. R4 needs it for the leakage audit, so it travels with the task rather than living in a side document.

difficulty.description: OPTIONAL and dangerous. Permitted only when derived from problem structure. A value derived from model pass rates is label leakage in disguise and must not be written here — see provenance.

difficulty_provenance.description: Required whenever difficulty is set. R4's leakage audit rejects any split whose tasks carry difficulty without provenance, and treats dataset_provided as suspect until its derivation is documented.
